# Lowest Hallowed

> Lowest Hallowed is Christian dark ambient and dungeon synth for prayer, with unblack undertones, composed by Steve Chab. A new album comes out each month, and listeners pray at the same time.

Long, slow, instrumental music made for prayer and intercession. Think neoclassical ambient with a darker edge. Once a month, listeners press play on the new album at the same time and pray on their own, each from where they are. Prayers and requests go in the chat on Bandcamp.
